title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, upgrade Actions and deps, improve cache hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Internal: Consolidate CI workflows and bump GitHub Actions + dev deps. No runtime or public API changes.
description: Motivation: our repo has accumulated many overlapping GH Actions workflows for linting, unit/integration tests and release automation over the last 18 months. That has led to duplicated job definitions, inconsistent cache keys, slow PR feedback loops and maintenance burden when bumping Actions or shared steps. This PR consolidates and standardizes lint/test/release workflows, upgrades key Actions and dev dependencies, and improves cache hygiene to reduce unnecessary cache churn. High-level changes: 1) Combine duplicate lint and test workflows into two consolidated workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml with conditional job matrices to keep PR feedback fast. 2) Replace several custom caching steps with the centralized cache-template and normalize cache keys across JS/TS/Python jobs to avoid separate cache misses. 3) Upgrade major GH Actions used by the repo (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-python@v4) and bump the node/image toolchain versions in CI. 4) Simplify release automation by consolidating publish steps into a single release pipeline with clearer semantic-release gating and faster preflight checks. 5) Update the build matrix to parallelize lint/test where safe and throttle integration tests to avoid noisy failures during peak CI usage. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and dedupe duplicated steps - [x] Add templated cache steps and consistent cache keys - [x] Upgrade GH Actions and pinned versions - [x] Run full monorepo test matrix and fix breakages - [x] Run dogfood CI for 48 hours on main prior to merge - [x] Document changes in CONTRIBUTING.md and internal infra docs. Why this is safe: all changes are CI-only and do not affect runtime code paths. Dev dep bumps were limited to test/build tooling; where tests failed I adjusted timeouts and pins to stabilize. Dogfood phase on main for 48h showed no regressions and average PR feedback time reduced ~22%.
commits: feat(ci): add consolidated lint and test workflows
chore(ci): introduce reusable cache-template and standardize cache keys
fix(tests): adjust integration test timeouts for new runners

Priya Singh: Actions bump LGTM but please call out any changes required for self-hosted runners.
Aisha Patel: Added comments and a helper script to map runner labels; self-hosted runners continue to use existing toolchains, no required changes.
Liam Chen: Cache key normalization looks good; had one suggestion to include repo commit shortsha fallback
Aisha Patel: Added fallback to cache key implementation.

Ethan Moore: Approving after re-run and dogfood (approved).
ci_run_history: initial CI run (2026-02-16) failed on integration timeout (flake); fixes applied (2026-02-17); re-run CI (2026-02-18) passed full matrix; dogfood monitoring (2026-02-18 to 2026-02-22) showed stability; merge gated on 48h dogfood and approvals.
impact_metrics: median PR CI time reduced from ~18m to ~14m; cache hit rate improved by ~30%; fewer spurious integration failures due to improved throttling.
notes_for_operators: When upgrading Actions again prefer a staged approach (bump one major at a time), and monitor self-hosted runner images for incompatible node/python versions.
